_doc: Registry of the DeepSc project (DeepSc, master index). A SUBSET of repo_master/repos.json (git-repos-master), narrowed to DeepSc repo family (Deep-ScX). Identical name/url/private/doc fields to that superset; the two must not disagree. This repo is an INDEX, not a container - see clone.sh for the clone/link model. Private members are linked only: the index exposes their name, never their content.
base_dir_doc: Clones live outside this index, as siblings in $CLOUD_GIT_BASE (default ~/git). This repo holds only committed symlinks pointing at them.
_visibility_doc: private:true repos require SSH access configured for this GitHub account to clone.

repos.name: DeepSc-X
repos.doc: Deep-ScX / saylitics: README and deployer wiring skeleton; the matching front-labtools project c-Stk_DsX/sailytics moves here with the labtools split (#1218). #1224.

_root_doc: No entries carry a group field - every member links at the root of this index, same as CG and front.
